messages:
Nadia Singh: Heads-up team - Marketplace go-to-market with IntegratorX is on May 18. Need crisp SI co-sell handoff rules before launch. Main asks: lead ownership window, mapping fields in SFDC, and customer-level announcement assets.

Diego Morales: Proposal: IntegratorX owns inbound marketplace leads for 5 business days. If no outreach by day 5 -> auto-escalate to Redwood inside AE. Keep exceptions for high-usage trials.

Priya Shah: 5 business days seems tight given time zones. Can we do 7 calendar days but require a 48h confirmation task from the SI? If confirm -> extend ownership.

Tom Hatcher: Agreed on 7d + 48h confirm task. Need exact field names so we can wire to automation: we use lead_source=marketplace_integratorx, si_partner_id, si_claimed_at, si_confirmed_at, auto_escalate_at.

Marketplace Bot: Draft playbook saved: https://confluence.redwood.ai/partners/integratorx-playbook (editable) :link:

Nadia Singh: Good. Also add a "trial_intent_score" calc: >0.6 prevents auto-escalation. Diego - can your team supply a simple webhook to push trial usage metrics into CRM?

Diego Morales: Yes, IntegratorX can POST trial usage. We'll send sample payload this afternoon. Format: {user_email, account_id, usage_pct, last_active}.

Priya Shah: For audit/compliance, we need opt-in language on the marketplace listing for data sharing with IntegratorX. I'll work with Legal and Marketing.

Tom Hatcher: On routing infra - recommend we implement an SFDC flow that marks si_claimed_at when SI clicks "Claim" on an intake record. If no claim within 48h -> create task for SI CSM, then at 7d auto-reassign.

Nadia Singh: Who will own building the SFDC flow and the webhook integration? @Diego can own SI side webhook. @Tom can you own SFDC flow?

Tom Hatcher: I can take SFDC flow. Will create a sprint ticket and tag eng-ops if we need middleware.

Marketplace Bot: Jira created: RED-4421 implement-integratorx-routing (assignee: Tom Hatcher) - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RED-4421

Diego Morales: Quick Q - how do we surface joint announcement assets to IntegratorX for their customer communications?

Priya Shah: We'll create a co-branded 1-pager + email template in Confluence and grant IntegratorX collaborator access. Also provide an asset pack (logo, short copy, 2 screenshots).

Nadia Singh: Timeline: playbook & SFDC mapping by EOD Thursday, webhook sample by Diego by EOD today, joint assets by next Tuesday. If anyone has blockers speak now. :hourglass: 

Tom Hatcher: No blockers from my side. I'll post the flow spec in the playbook.

Diego Morales: On it - posting webhook sample in the slack thread later today.

Priya Shah: I'll loop Legal and post the privacy blurb.

Marketplace Bot: Reminder: Product review call scheduled May 10, 10am PT. Invite sent.

Nadia Singh: Thanks all. Will consolidate playbook items and ping marketing for announcement calendar. :rocket:
